description: Companion sensitivity: prior-mean epistemic scenarios (k_aq field-test population vs the OYO Form-5 analysis constants vs the regional upper band; gamma_bl_sub in-situ lower bound) against the frozen scenario-off production baseline. Baseline files untouched.

scenarios.label: k_aq_field_toe
scenarios.basis: KP1.8R-2 landside-toe field permeability, 5.15E-02 cm/s (2005/06 campaign)

scenarios.label: k_aq_field_geomean
scenarios.basis: geometric mean of the six-member field-test population (4 OYO 1999 + 2 new)

scenarios.label: gamma_bl_sub_lower
scenarios.basis: lowest of three in-situ sand-replacement densities (1.61 g/cm3 -> 5.98)

scenarios.label: k_aq_regional_upper
scenarios.basis: upper end of the Chiyoda new-channel regional band 1e-3..1e-2 m/s (tokachi_chisuishi_2023); the unconservative end of the bracket, flagged in the thesis Discussion as beyond the prior's 95th percentile
